items.title: Rotem's Sky Letters
items.summary: A Flappy-Bird-style game: read the syllable or Hebrew word out loud and the bird flies through the gate. Levels get faster and add golden, moving, double and triple gates; 17 birds with their own powers; badges.

items.title: דגי המספרים
items.summary: A fishing game: a voice asks for a number (then a count, a sum or a difference) and the child taps the fish carrying the answer. Nine levels, a new fish species for the aquarium after each one.

items.title: מעבדת הנייר המעופף
items.summary: Why planes fly: 8 home missions with sheets of paper, a Bernoulli tube simulator, a wind tunnel, a paper-plane flight log and a pilot certificate.

items.title: מעבדת הצליל
items.summary: See your voice on a live oscilloscope, measure pitch in Hz, build a straw flute and a rubber-band guitar, tune water glasses to a scale, mix waves, and race lightning against thunder.

items.title: כמה ארוכה שנה?
skills: the tropical year and the lunar month
items.summary: How long the Earth takes to circle the Sun, and how the Gregorian, Hebrew and Islamic calendars correct for it. Leap-year rules in each; every mission unlocks only after the child calculates the corrections.
